source_art: 85 individually generated assets; modular variants assembled from the new art

integration.terrain_detail_underlay: Interior tiles contain genuine alpha cracks. Put existing terrain backing behind them; edge and corner overlays mask the front artwork only.
integration.tile_repeat: Repeat on the listed axis at step_px. Do not auto-trim sprites.
integration.static_magic: Runes, rings, trails and particles are independent static overlays.
integration.scale: Assets are authored in pixel space; place at 1× before applying a common world scale.

assets.description: One isolated distant ancient ruin silhouette: a small group of connected broken columns and one partial arch, muted dusty blue-green palette and low contrast, simple atmospheric soft cel shading. No sky, mountains, ground, scenery or fog rectangle. Transparent around and between architecture.

One isolated tall decorative ancient tree TRUNK only, full visible root flare below, thick brown-grey twisted trunk branching into three short sawn/broken upper limbs, small moss accents. No leaf canopy, terrain or background. Side elevation, muted back-layer palette.

One isolated tall decorative tree trunk variation, narrow leaning hollow trunk with a large oval knot hole, long buttress root and two broken upper branches. Whole silhouette visible. Muted desaturated olive-brown background palette, no leaves or scenery.

One separate wide tangled ancient root overlay, soft desaturated brown-grey roots weaving horizontally, thin strands and transparent gaps. No host tree, earth, rocks or scene. Lower contrast intended behind gameplay.

One separate hanging curtain of three sparse forest vines with small leaves, muted blue-green color, different lengths, graceful curving strands, transparent between all vines. Whole attachment tips and ends visible. No canopy or scene.
